data.name: Muhsinaat
data.gender_notes: Muhsinaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muhsinaat is an Arabic name that signifies a person who performs good deeds and charitable acts. It is a virtuous name that reflects a strong moral character. The name Muhsinaat carries the meaning “Doer of Good Deeds” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhsinaat usually hope their child will grow to embody doer of good deeds and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Muhsinaat is a name that embodies the Quranic concept of doing good and being righteous (Quran 3:134).
data.etymology: Muhsinaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Doer of Good Deeds.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhsinaat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Muhsinaat
in_english.meaning: Women who do good and charitable deeds
in_english.long_meaning: Muhsinaat refers to women who engage in acts of goodness, charity, and kindness with sincerity and a good intention. They are characterized by their good morals, noble qualities, and righteous actions, as mentioned in the Quran and the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The term is derived from the Arabic root 'h-s-n' which means 'to do good' or 'to be beautiful'. In Islamic tradition, Muhsinaat are considered role models for their piety, compassion, and generosity.
